remarks: WHERE LAKE LIFE MEETS TIMELESS LUXURY. Welcome to your Silver Lake escape, a beautifully reimagined year-round lake house where thoughtful design, extensive renovations and the unmistakable magic of waterfront living come together. It is clear that this is a home that has been loved, improved and transformed with intention. 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, 2 half baths, this charming lake house has undergone an extraordinary renovation, nearly every inch of the property thoughtfully updated since 2020. The transformation began with a complete renovation of the kitchen, flooring, back bedroom and second-floor half bath. All-new plumbing, electrical, a new water softener, tankless hw system and upgraded 150-amp electrical service. The vision continued in 25/26 with the complete remodeling of the living room, new flooring, and the addition of a beautiful front bedroom suite with an upstairs balcony, the perfect place to take in the peaceful surroundings. A covered deck provides another inviting space to gather with friends, enjoy dinner overlooking the water or simply slow down and savor lake life. The main portion of the home also features a newer roof. From the systems behind the walls to the finishes you see every day, this home has been extensively updated to offer the comfort and ease of modern living while preserving the charm that makes a lake house feel like home. Two storage sheds also added for all of your lake toys and equipment. And then there is Silver Lake. Here, your days can be measured in sunsets, boat rides, quiet mornings overlooking the water and evenings spent gathered with the people you love. Whether you’re enjoying summer on the lake, watching the seasons change from your covered deck or cozying up inside during the winter months, this is a property designed to be enjoyed in every season. This is a place to make traditions, host family and friends, escape the everyday and create the kind of memories that last for generations. Beautifully renovated. Thoughtfully designed. Actual square footage measures 1,526 due to additions and updates not included in the public record's square footage.
